description: Search EvalGate's public REST API operations by keyword. Use it to find the right endpoint before writing an API call. Returns matching operations with method, path, summary and operationId; for product guides use the documentation MCP instead.

limit.description: Maximum matching operations, from 1 to 20; defaults to 10.

query.description: Search terms for the public OpenAPI operation catalog (1–200 characters); all whitespace-separated terms must match.

name: docs_search

deepLink.description: EvalGate web path or absolute URL for inspecting these results.
